instanceRequest: I want to deposit USDC into Morpho's Hyperithm USDC Apex vault. build me the template and its report

role.en: The vault you deposit into: Hyperithm USDC Apex (hyperUSDCa), a Morpho Vault V2 curated by Hyperithm
role.zh-TW: 你存入的 vault：Hyperithm USDC Apex（hyperUSDCa），Hyperithm 管理的 Morpho Vault V2

text.en: Morpho's app curator page for Hyperithm holds this address only in its scripts, so no program reads it there
text.zh-TW: Morpho app 的 Hyperithm curator 頁只在 script 裡有這個地址，程式讀不到

text.en: Morpho's API GET /v0/vaults-v2/1:<vault> answers name Hyperithm USDC Apex, version 2.0, asset USDC, factory 0xA1D94F746dEfa1928926b84fB2596c06926C0405, created at block 23666454
text.zh-TW: Morpho API GET /v0/vaults-v2/1:<vault> 回答名稱 Hyperithm USDC Apex、版本 2.0、資產 USDC、工廠 0xA1D94F746dEfa1928926b84fB2596c06926C0405、建立於區塊 23666454

text.en: Hyperithm's own site lists no vault or address, and CoinGecko lists no coin at this address; the factory is the one other place
text.zh-TW: Hyperithm 官網沒有列出 vault 或地址，CoinGecko 在這個地址也沒有幣；工廠是唯一的另一個地方

text.en: Etherscan: verified contract VaultV2 (solc 0.8.28), creator 0xC56EA16EA06B0a6A7b3B03B2f48751e549bE40fD, creation transaction 0xc686b128ceefbc78ba7dda6200bb2cad696709c9b7a54d1d753a5956b456f3ce
text.zh-TW: Etherscan：已驗證合約 VaultV2（solc 0.8.28），建立者 0xC56EA16EA06B0a6A7b3B03B2f48751e549bE40fD，建立交易 0xc686b128ceefbc78ba7dda6200bb2cad696709c9b7a54d1d753a5956b456f3ce

role.en: The vault's only adapter, into Morpho Blue markets; a deposit reads its assets to price your shares, and allocators lend through it later
role.zh-TW: vault 唯一的轉接合約，通往 Morpho Blue 市場；deposit 讀它的資產來計算份額價格，allocator 之後經由它借出

text.en: Morpho's API GET /v0/vaults-v2/1:<vault>/allocations answers adapter_address 0x92872B97d89B54646D036E3aFd2BcCb84d8e3CA1, kind morpho_market_v1_v2, the only adapter
text.zh-TW: Morpho API GET /v0/vaults-v2/1:<vault>/allocations 回答 adapter_address 0x92872B97d89B54646D036E3aFd2BcCb84d8e3CA1、種類 morpho_market_v1_v2，是唯一的轉接合約

text.en: On chain the vault answers adaptersLength() = 1, adapters(0) = this address, and liquidityAdapter() = the zero address
text.zh-TW: 鏈上 vault 回答 adaptersLength() = 1、adapters(0) = 這個地址、liquidityAdapter() = 零地址

text.en: The Morpho app's vault page shows it only through scripts, so no program reads it there
text.zh-TW: Morpho app 的 vault 頁只用 script 顯示它，程式讀不到

text.en: Etherscan: verified contract MorphoMarketV1AdapterV2 (solc 0.8.28), creator 0x594c5eE5a326295FF6212C31BB3311747D3bD562, creation transaction 0xaf994d0873fd976667769dc37a6249d5413cb2a5720fd331b32a7e3ec87382da
text.zh-TW: Etherscan：已驗證合約 MorphoMarketV1AdapterV2（solc 0.8.28），建立者 0x594c5eE5a326295FF6212C31BB3311747D3bD562，建立交易 0xaf994d0873fd976667769dc37a6249d5413cb2a5720fd331b32a7e3ec87382da

text.en: A mid-sized curated vault whose size swung from 0.16 million to 25.5 million and back within months, one holder has 53.9%, and only the factory confirms its address.
text.zh-TW: 中型 curated vault，規模幾個月內從 16 萬衝到 2,550 萬又回落，最大持有者占 53.9%，地址只有工廠能確認。

text.en: The bundle pulls the approved USDC from the Safe
text.zh-TW: bundle 從 Safe 拉走已授權的 USDC

text.en: The bundle deposits it into the vault, shares minted to the Safe
text.zh-TW: bundle 存進 vault，份額鑄給 Safe

text.en: The vault held about 0.16 million USDC on 2025-12-30, 25.5 million on 2026-01-29, 3.8 million on 2026-02-28 and 7.2 million now. 168 addresses hold shares; the top 10 hold 86.32%, the largest 53.90%.

recommendation.en: One holder owns over half; if it leaves, the vault's idle USDC can run short, so plan when you will withdraw.
recommendation.zh-TW: 一個持有者占一半以上；它撤出時 vault 可提領的 USDC 可能不足，存入前想好何時提領。

text.en: Two Morpho vaults are named Hyperithm USDC Apex (hyperUSDCa): this Vault V2 and the older MetaMorpho vault 0x777791C4d6DC2CE140D00D2828a7C93503c67777, which shrank from 37.7 to 0.8 million USDC this year.
text.zh-TW: Morpho 上有兩個 vault 都叫 Hyperithm USDC Apex（hyperUSDCa）：這個 Vault V2，和較舊的 MetaMorpho vault 0x777791C4d6DC2CE140D00D2828a7C93503c67777，後者今年從 3,770 萬縮到 80 萬 USDC。

recommendation.en: This report covers only the Vault V2. Check that the app's vault address is this one before you sign.
recommendation.zh-TW: 這份報告只涵蓋 Vault V2。簽名前確認 app 上的 vault 地址就是這一個。

text.en: No Safe deposited into this vault through VaultBundlesV1 in the year studied, so the tests hold no Safe transaction of this vault; two EOAs' deposits made the same call and are traced.
text.zh-TW: 研究的一年內沒有 Safe 經由 VaultBundlesV1 存入這個 vault，所以測試沒有這個 vault 的 Safe 交易；兩個 EOA 的存款做了相同呼叫並有追蹤記錄。

recommendation.en: Expect the first Safe deposit here to be yours; read verify's output in full.
recommendation.zh-TW: 這裡第一筆 Safe 存款可能就是你的；完整看過 verify 的輸出。

title.en: Your USDC stays in the vault at first
title.zh-TW: USDC 一開始留在 vault 裡

text.en: A deposit stays in the vault as idle USDC until an allocator lends it out: the vault sets no liquidity adapter, so deposit only reads its one market adapter's assets to price your shares.
text.zh-TW: 存款先以閒置 USDC 留在 vault，直到 allocator 把它借出：vault 沒有設定流動性轉接合約，所以 deposit 只讀它唯一的市場轉接合約的資產來計算份額價格。

text.en: The factory answers isVaultV2 = true for 0x093272C07700d3cA5301C3Bf9B3A392624179E2F. Morpho's API v0 vaults-v2 answers this address as Hyperithm USDC Apex. The app's curator page shows it only with scripts, which I could not run; Hyperithm's site and CoinGecko list nothing.
text.zh-TW: 工廠對 0x093272C07700d3cA5301C3Bf9B3A392624179E2F 回答 isVaultV2 = true。Morpho API v0 vaults-v2 回答這個地址是 Hyperithm USDC Apex。app 的 curator 頁只用 script 顯示，我無法執行；Hyperithm 官網和 CoinGecko 都沒列出。

recommendation.en: Open the Morpho app's Hyperithm USDC Apex page and compare the address yourself.
recommendation.zh-TW: 自己打開 Morpho app 的 Hyperithm USDC Apex 頁面比對地址。
